rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0001
rows.name:
Knight! A warrior of loyalty! Knight!!
An apostle of love!

rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0002
rows.name:
Well, well, well... You've finally
earned the right to stand shoulder
to shoulder with me!

rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0003
rows.name:
From now on, I'll grant you special
permission to call me 'Comrade of
Love'!

rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0004
rows.name:
So don't hold back. From now on, call
me Comrade of Love Narsus! Go on! Go
on!

rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0005
rows.name:
Huh?! You just want to be normal
friends? Oh, well... OK... I
think we can agree on that.

rows.label: tlk70000122_10_msg0006
rows.name:
Friends... Ha! Friends! That has
a nice ring to it! I think I can
get used to this, friends!
